===
Real-world: PTC behaviour
===
function f_ptc() runs on PTC {
  timer t := 2.0;
  p.send(Req:{id := 1});
  t.start;
  alt {
    [] p.receive(Resp:?) -> value v { setverdict(pass); }
    [] t.timeout { setverdict(fail); }
  }
}
---
(Root
  Nodes: (ModuleDef
    Def: (FuncDecl KindTok: "function"
      Name: (Ident "f_ptc")
      Params: (FormalPars)
      RunsOn: (RunsOnSpec RunsTok: "runs" OnTok: "on"
        Comp: (Ident "PTC"))
      Body: (BlockStmt
        Stmts: (DeclStmt
          Decl: (ValueDecl
            Type: (Ident "timer")
            Decls: (Declarator AssignTok: ":="
              Name: (Ident "t")
              Value: (ValueLiteral "2.0"))))
        Stmts: (ExprStmt
          Expr: (CallExpr
            Fun: (SelectorExpr
              X: (Ident "p")
              Sel: (Ident "send"))
            Args: (ParenExpr
              List: (BinaryExpr Op: ":"
                X: (Ident "Req")
                Y: (CompositeLiteral
                  List: (BinaryExpr Op: ":="
                    X: (Ident "id")
                    Y: (ValueLiteral "1")))))))
        Stmts: (ExprStmt
          Expr: (SelectorExpr
            X: (Ident "t")
            Sel: (Ident "start")))
        Stmts: (AltStmt Tok: "alt"
          Body: (BlockStmt
            Stmts: (CommClause
              Comm: (ExprStmt
                Expr: (RedirectExpr Tok: "->" ValueTok: "value"
                  X: (CallExpr
                    Fun: (SelectorExpr
                      X: (Ident "p")
                      Sel: (Ident "receive"))
                    Args: (ParenExpr
                      List: (BinaryExpr Op: ":"
                        X: (Ident "Resp")
                        Y: (ValueLiteral "?"))))
                  Value: (Ident "v")))
              Body: (BlockStmt
                Stmts: (ExprStmt
                  Expr: (CallExpr
                    Fun: (Ident "setverdict")
                    Args: (ParenExpr
                      List: (ValueLiteral "pass"))))))
            Stmts: (CommClause
              Comm: (ExprStmt
                Expr: (SelectorExpr
                  X: (Ident "t")
                  Sel: (Ident "timeout")))
              Body: (BlockStmt
                Stmts: (ExprStmt
                  Expr: (CallExpr
                    Fun: (Ident "setverdict")
                    Args: (ParenExpr
                      List: (ValueLiteral "fail"))))))))))))

===
Real-world: test configuration
===
testcase tc() runs on MTC system SYS {
  var PTC c := PTC.create alive;
  map(c:p, system:p);
  c.start(f_ptc());
  c.done;
  unmap(c:p, system:p);
}
---
(Root
  Nodes: (ModuleDef
    Def: (FuncDecl KindTok: "testcase"
      Name: (Ident "tc")
      Params: (FormalPars)
      RunsOn: (RunsOnSpec RunsTok: "runs" OnTok: "on"
        Comp: (Ident "MTC"))
      System: (SystemSpec Tok: "system"
        Comp: (Ident "SYS"))
      Body: (BlockStmt
        Stmts: (DeclStmt
          Decl: (ValueDecl KindTok: "var"
            Type: (Ident "PTC")
            Decls: (Declarator AssignTok: ":="
              Name: (Ident "c")
              Value: (UnaryExpr Op: "alive"
                X: (SelectorExpr
                  X: (Ident "PTC")
                  Sel: (Ident "create"))))))
